name: Keeper Rhys

intro.text: Ha! You made it to Cardiff in one piece! Dry, too, which is frankly suspicious.
Rhys. Storm Stone. I play second row on Saturdays and I'm the one who gets rained on the rest of the week.
Right then. Forwards up front, backs out wide, and nobody drops the ball. Kick off!

win: Try! Under the posts, no argument. That's a proper performance. Take the Stone, you've earned the full eighty minutes.
after: Next time we'll do it in the rain. Oh, it IS raining. Always is. Great stuff.
